ranks: Ravnica: City of Guilds (RAV, 2005-10-07): the rest of the set, 77 left after batch 229 (the second middle walk's seventh batch, which finishes its range); no engine change

blocked.name: Spawnbroker
blocked.why: Exchange control of target creature you control and target creature with power less than or equal to its power — no exchange of control, and no target filter comparing one target's power with another's.

blocked.name: Bottled Cloister
blocked.why: Exiles its controller's hand face down and returns those cards at the next upkeep — no linked face-down exile of a whole hand.

blocked.name: Chorus of the Conclave
blocked.why: Creature spells you cast may be cast paying any amount of additional mana, entering with that many +1/+1 counters — no such optional cost.

blocked.name: Mark of Eviction
blocked.why: Returns the enchanted creature and all Auras attached to it — no filter for the Auras attached to the creature this Aura enchants.

blocked.name: Grifter's Blade
blocked.why: As this Equipment enters, you may attach it to a creature you control — a replacement choice on entering, which an enters trigger would not be.

blocked.name: Ghosts of the Innocent
blocked.why: Damage dealt is halved, rounded down — not prevention (the ruling), and the affected player orders it against doublers (616.1); the damage replacement has only integer multipliers.

blocked.name: Screeching Griffin
blocked.why: Target creature can't block this creature this turn — no restriction tying "can't block" to one attacker.

blocked.name: Molten Sentry
blocked.why: As it enters, flip a coin: a 5/2 with haste or a 2/5 with defender — chooseOnEnter can't flip a coin or set base P/T and keywords.

blocked.name: Trophy Hunter
blocked.why: Whenever a creature with flying dealt damage by this creature this turn dies — damagedThisTurnBy can't name "this creature".

blocked.name: Festival of the Guildpact
blocked.why: Prevent the next X damage that would be dealt to you this turn — prevent-damage has no untargeted shield on "you".

blocked.name: Lurking Informant
blocked.why: Look at the top card of target player's library, you may put it into the graveyard — look-and-choose reads only your own library outside a for-each-player.

blocked.name: Crown of Convergence
blocked.why: As long as the top card of your library is a creature card, creatures you control that share a color with it get +1/+1 — no such condition or filter.

blocked.name: Sabertooth Alley Cat
blocked.why: Creatures without defender can't block this creature this turn — cantBeBlockedBy is static only.

blocked.name: Terraformer
blocked.why: Each land you control becomes the basic land type of your choice until end of turn — no effect sets land types en masse.

blocked.name: Gaze of the Gorgon
blocked.why: Destroy each creature that blocked or was blocked by the target this turn (the ruling: blocks before the spell count) — no such filter.

blocked.name: Selesnya Sagittars
blocked.why: Can block an additional creature each combat — no such static.

blocked.name: Bramble Elemental
blocked.why: Whenever an Aura becomes attached to this creature — no such trigger.

blocked.name: Leashling
blocked.why: Put a card from your hand on top of your library: return this to its owner's hand — no such cost.

blocked.name: Excruciator
blocked.why: Damage that would be dealt by this creature can't be prevented — no such effect.

blocked.name: Sins of the Past
blocked.why: Until end of turn, you may cast target instant or sorcery from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, exiling it instead — grant-graveyard-cast can neither waive the cost nor exile it.

blocked.name: Wojek Apothecary
blocked.why: Radiance: prevent the next 1 damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it — prevent-damage covers one target only.

blocked.name: Dream Leash
blocked.why: "You can't choose an untapped permanent as this spell's target" binds only the cast; an Aura's target spec is also its enchant restriction, which the state check re-reads, so a tapped filter would drop it once the permanent untaps (the ruling).

blocked.name: Incite Hysteria
blocked.why: Radiance: the target and each creature sharing a color with it can't block this turn — a fixed set at resolution (611.2c); restrict with a filter is a turn-wide rule that catches later creatures.

blocked.name: Mausoleum Turnkey
blocked.why: Return target creature card of an opponent's choice from your graveyard — an opponent picks the target.
